_template.title: Missing-information notice
_template.summary: Test the notice sent when an application is missing information or a document.
_template.good_for: Applications stalled waiting on the applicant, repeat requests, denials for failure to provide information.
_template.typical_change: Saying exactly what is missing and how to send it, in plain language, with one clear deadline.
